limitations: Scenario policies are illustrative, not optimal strategies.
Narrative stages may choose professional outcomes when their proof was not earned by that reading time; this is intentional, not an automatic happy-ending simulator.
Temporary memory aging and trust contributions are evaluated, but all old-grudge repair branches and every tactical cooperation restriction are not exhaustively exercised.
Input mission contributions are stipulated, not proof that the full combat board can produce them.
